purpose: check that lj075_observable_dt.level_observables reproduces prl_toy_models.compute_observables (project definitions) on a real trajectory
settings: origins t0 = 1, 2, 3 (compute_observables origins=3 on the slice, starts 0/100/200); lags 0-200 frames (0-2); VCCF edges [0, 1.59, 2.55, L/2]; current shells k1, k2, k4 (per-mode normalized, shell mean); van Hove 60 bins to L/2 at t = 0, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2
note: run for the report revision after the analysis (the original development check had not been saved); read-only, uses the analysis code unchanged in level_observables
script:
# Re-check: lj075_observable_dt.level_observables vs prl_toy_models.compute_observables on a real trajectory.
import sys, json, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/user/ass1/ewald_longitudinal")
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/user/ass1/ewald_longitudinal/toy_models")
import lj075_observable_dt as O
import prl_toy_models as P
f = O.RAWDIR / "A_rep101_L4_T10.npz"
dt = 0.01
with np.load(f) as z:
    Q, V = z[f"Q_{dt}"], z[f"V_{dt}"]
a0, T = 100, 401          # frames 100..500 (t = 1..5); limit 200 lags; starts 0,100,200 -> origins t = 1, 2, 3
Qs, Vs = Q[a0:a0 + T].astype(float), V[a0:a0 + T].astype(float)
t = np.arange(T) * dt
ref = {}
for name, modes in O.BASE["observables"]["currents"]["shells"].items():
    ref[name] = P.compute_observables(Qs, Vs, t, O.L, max_lag=200, n_lags=201, origins=3, r_bins=60,
                                      vccf_edges=O.BASE["observables"]["vccf"]["bins"], modes=modes)
r0 = ref["k1"]
assert list(r0["time_origins"]) == [0, 100, 200] and len(r0["lag_frames"]) == 201
mine = O.level_observables(Q, V, dt, np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]))
out = {}
out["vacf"] = float(np.max(np.abs(mine["vacf"] - r0["vacf"])))
out["vccf"] = float(np.max(np.abs(mine["vccf"] - r0["vccf_normalized"].T)))
for name in ref:
    out[f"CL_{name}"] = float(np.max(np.abs(mine[f"CL_{name}"] - ref[name]["hydro_L"].mean(1))))
    out[f"CT_{name}"] = float(np.max(np.abs(mine[f"CT_{name}"] - ref[name]["hydro_T"].mean(1))))
vh_t = O.BASE["observables"]["van_hove"]["times"]
out["gd"] = float(np.max(np.abs(mine["gd"] - r0["van_hove_distinct"][[int(round(x / 0.01)) for x in vh_t]])))
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
print("scale vacf", np.abs(r0["vacf"]).max(), "gd max", r0["van_hove_distinct"].max())
